decisions.reason: Uses ls-remote listing (v0.9.5 absent) and sync-script's HEAD:main-only push to explain the attempt-1 ref-resolution failure; explicitly rules out network, typo, outage.
Explains v0.9.7 targets the newer 0.1.2-alpha.1 API whose useConversation seat is absent on the frozen 0.1.1-rc.2 host, so install success and restarts prove nothing.

Picks v0.9.3 via rc.1 verification plus additive rc.2 note, notes it is also missing from the mirror, gates install on maintainer tag publication and verification; fallback via origin is conditional with no invented SHA, and upgrade is explicitly refused.
Non-forced per-mirror refs/tags pushes inside the existing sync loop plus ls-remote verification per mirror; branch-only sync identified as insufficient.

README routes by runtime via an explicit matrix (rc line to v0.9.3, alpha.1 to v0.9.7) with version check, matrix-as-release-gate, and install-time runtime declaration; no blanket newest-tag default or open-ended alpha support.
